mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId,reward_id AS rewardId,campaign_id AS campaignId,organization_id AS organizationId,shop_id AS shopId,participant_id AS participantId,relation_id AS relationId, beneficiary_key AS beneficiaryKey,rule_id AS ruleId,CAST(rule_json AS CHAR) AS ruleJson,mode,threshold_count AS threshold,entitlement_state AS entitlementState,quota_state AS quotaState,row_version AS revision,authorization_state AS authorizationState,delivery_state AS deliveryState FROM mk_referral_reward WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reward_id=#{reward} FOR UPDATE
SELECT state FROM mk_referral_participant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND participant_id=#{participant} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_referral_quota_account(tenant_id,campaign_id,rule_id,organization_id,shop_id,rule_json,quota_limit,bucket_count,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{campaign},#{rule},#{r.organizationId},#{r.shopId},#{ruleJson},#{limit},#{buckets},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quota_limit=quota_limit
mapper.select: SELECT organization_id AS organizationId,shop_id AS shopId,CAST(rule_json AS CHAR) AS ruleJson,quota_limit AS quotaLimit,bucket_count AS bucketCount FROM mk_referral_quota_account WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND campaign_id=#{campaign} AND rule_id=#{rule} FOR UPDATE

SELECT allocated,available,reserved,consumed,fencing_epoch AS epoch,row_version AS version FROM mk_referral_quota_bucket WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND campaign_id=#{campaign} AND rule_id=#{rule} AND bucket_id=#{bucket} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_referral_subject_quota(tenant_id,campaign_id,rule_id,beneficiary_key,quota_limit,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{campaign},#{rule},#{subject},#{subjectLimit},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE row_version=row_version
mapper.select: SELECT quota_limit AS quotaLimit,reserved_count AS reserved,consumed_count AS consumed,row_version AS version FROM mk_referral_subject_quota WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND campaign_id=#{campaign} AND rule_id=#{rule} AND beneficiary_key=#{subject} FOR UPDATE

SELECT participant_id AS participantId,beneficiary_key AS beneficiaryKey,bucket_id AS bucketId,created_epoch AS createdEpoch,state,terminal_fact AS terminalFact,terminal_digest AS terminalDigest,success_digest AS successDigest,row_version AS revision FROM mk_referral_quota_reservation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reward_id=#{reward} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_referral_reward SET quota_state='RESERVED',row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reward_id=#{reward} AND row_version=#{r.revision} AND quota_state='WAIT_QUOTA' AND entitlement_state='ELIGIBLE'

UPDATE mk_referral_quota_reservation SET state='RELEASED',terminal_fact='CANCELLED_BEFORE_ISSUE',terminal_digest=#{terminalDigest},row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reward_id=#{reward} AND state='RESERVED' AND bucket_id=#{bucket} AND beneficiary_key=#{subject}

UPDATE mk_referral_reward SET quota_state='RELEASED',row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reward_id=#{reward} AND row_version=#{r.revision} AND entitlement_state='INVALIDATED' AND authorization_state='NONE' AND delivery_state='NOT_SUBMITTED' AND quota_state='RESERVED'

UPDATE mk_referral_quota_reservation SET state=#{final.state},terminal_fact=#{final.terminalFact},terminal_digest=#{final.terminalDigest},success_digest=#{final.successDigest},row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reward_id=#{reward} AND row_version=#{reservationRevision}
UPDATE mk_referral_reward SET quota_state=#{final.state},row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reward_id=#{reward} AND row_version=#{r.revision}
mapper.select: SELECT valid_count FROM mk_referral_progress WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND participant_id=#{participant}

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN q.counted=FALSE OR q.state<>'ELIGIBLE' OR t.status<>'DONE' OR t.requested_revision<>t.processed_revision OR t.relation_id IS NULL OR (q.evidence_resource_id IS NOT NULL AND (c.resource_id IS NULL OR c.row_version<>q.evidence_state_version OR c.quarantined=TRUE)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END FROM mk_referral_qualification q LEFT JOIN mk_referral_evaluation_task t ON t.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND t.relation_id=q.relation_id LEFT JOIN mk_referral_order_evidence_current c ON c.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND c.resource_id=q.evidence_resource_id WHERE q.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND q.participant_id=#{participant} AND q.relation_id=#{relation}AND q.counted=TRUE
